settings.custom_liquid:
{%- liquid assign p = closest.product | default: product | default: card_product | default: product_resource assign variant = p.selected_or_first_available_variant assign tiers = blank assign max_bp = 0 assign is_price_on_request = false if p != blank assign mf = p.metafields.custom.volume_discounts if mf != blank assign v = mf.value if v != blank and v.tiers != blank assign tiers = v.tiers else assign s = v | default: mf | to_s if s != blank assign parsed = s | parse_json if parsed != blank and parsed.tiers != blank assign tiers = parsed.tiers endif endif endif endif if tiers != blank for t in tiers assign d = t.discount | default: 0 | plus: 0 if d > 1 assign d = d | divided_by: 100.0 endif assign bp = d | times: 10000 | round if bp > 9900 assign bp = 9900 endif if bp > max_bp assign max_bp = bp endif endfor endif assign base_incl = p.price_min assign factor_bp = 10000 | minus: max_bp assign from_incl = base_incl | times: factor_bp | divided_by: 10000 if base_incl <= 2 or from_incl <= 2 assign is_price_on_request = true endif endif assign status_text = 'Op voorraad' if p == blank or variant == blank or is_price_on_request assign status_text = 'Snelle afhandeling' else if variant.inventory_management == 'shopify' if variant.inventory_quantity > 0 assign status_text = 'Op voorraad' else if variant.inventory_policy == 'continue' assign status_text = 'Snelle afhandeling' else assign status_text = 'Beschikbaar op aanvraag' endif endif else assign status_text = 'Op voorraad' endif endif -%}
